export.intro: Download a ZIP with your profile, posts with their targets and publishing attempts, connected accounts (without credentials), API key names, the audit log, approvals and your media files. Passwords, keys and tokens are never included.
export.preparing: Preparing your export. You can leave this page; it is ready when you come back.
export.ready: Your export ({size}) is ready. The download link works for 5 minutes; the file is deleted on {date}.
export.failed: The last export could not be built. Nothing was kept; try again.
export.expired: Your last export expired and was deleted. Request a new one.
export.cooldown: A new export can be requested 24 hours after the last one.

deleteAccount.heading: Delete account
deleteAccount.intro: Deletes your account, posts, media, connected accounts, API keys and audit log. It happens {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after you confirm. Until then you can sign in and cancel; scheduled posts are set back to drafts and every session and API key is signed out right away. Download your data first if you want a copy.
deleteAccount.dialogBody: Everything you own in Steerpost is deleted after the grace period. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.wrongPassword: That is not your current password.
deleteAccount.wrongConfirm: Type your email address exactly as shown.
deleteAccount.reauthBody: For your security, sign in again to delete your account. You come back to Settings afterwards.

signIn.intro: The ways you can sign in to Steerpost. Keep at least one.
signIn.loadFailed: Could not load your sign-in methods
signIn.providersFailed: Could not load the providers you can connect.
signIn.passwordOn: You can sign in with your email and password.
signIn.passwordOff: You have no password. You sign in with a provider.
signIn.newPasswordHint: 8 to 128 characters. Your other browser sessions are signed out when you save.
signIn.passwordSetDone: Password set. Your other sessions were signed out.
signIn.disabledNote: {provider} sign-in is switched off on this server. You can still disconnect it.
signIn.connectBody: You go to {provider} to approve the connection, then come back here. After that you can sign in with it.
signIn.disconnectBody: You can no longer sign in with {provider}. Your posts and connected social accounts stay.
signIn.wrongPassword: That is not your current password.
signIn.lastMethod: Keep at least one way to sign in. Set a password or connect another provider first.
signIn.reauthBody: For your security, sign in again to make this change. You come back to Settings afterwards.
signIn.noProviders: No sign-in providers are set up on this server. You sign in with your email and password.

signIn.reauthUnavailable: None of the providers you signed up with is available on this server, so you cannot sign in again here. Ask the person who runs this server for help.
signIn.connectConflict: That provider is already connected, or this account is waiting to be deleted. Reload the page to see where things stand.
signIn.connectUnavailable: This server does not offer that provider any more. Reload the page to see what is available.
